egress_feature_decision.rationale: common covers direct/HTTP/SOCKS TCP; pproxy-compat is required by from_pproxy_uri; extended covers documented Shadowsocks/Trojan; pproxy-legacy and legacy-crypto retain documented SSR with the Python cipher surface; ssh retains the documented optional SSH upstream. Listener operations, reverse control channels, and QUIC are outside EggPool provider TCP transport.
